mcat_description.short: FRP Portable Security Cabin is a prefabricated, single-person guard shelter made from Fibre Reinforced Plastic (FRP) panels on a mild steel structural frame, sold as a complete ready-to-install unit per piece.
mcat_description.long: FRP Portable Security Cabins are factory-manufactured guard shelters constructed with FRP moulded wall panels (typically 5–7 mm thick), MS angle/square tube structural frame, FRP or pyramid-shaped roof, aluminium sliding windows, and an FRP door — delivered as a complete, portable unit. They serve as a lightweight, corrosion-resistant, and weather-proof alternative to brick-and-mortar watchman rooms, offering easy relocation and rapid installation without civil work. Standard footprints range from 4×4 ft to 8×8 ft with a uniform height of 7–8.5 ft, and buyers can specify custom dimensions, roof style (flat, pyramid/Kerala), colour, and electrical fittings. The category is dominated by small-to-mid-scale FRP fabricators concentrated in Pune, Gujarat, and Maharashtra, supplying to housing societies, construction sites, industrial plants, and commercial premises across India.

market_context: FRP Portable Security Cabins are a well-established product category in the Indian prefabricated structures market, primarily manufactured by small-to-mid-scale FRP fabricators concentrated in Pune (Maharashtra), Vapi and Umbergaon (Gujarat), and Pimpri-Chinchwad. The product is known in the trade by multiple names — 'watchman cabin,' 'guard cabin,' 'fiber cabin,' and 'chowkidar cabin' — with 'watchman cabin' being the dominant Google search term (highest impressions) and 'FRP portable security cabin' being the dominant on-platform search term. Standard catalogue sizes are 4×4 ft, 4×6 ft, 6×4 ft, 6×6 ft, 8×6 ft, and 8×8 ft, all with a standard height of 7–8.5 ft; buyers frequently specify dimensions in their search queries. Wall construction uses FRP moulded panels (5–7 mm solid or 25–50 mm sandwich with insulation) on MS square tube/angle frame; roofs are either flat or pyramid-shaped (locally called 'Kerala roof'). The category sits within the broader Prefabricated Structures taxonomy alongside MS portable cabins, GI porta cabins, and ACP cabins — FRP is differentiated by its corrosion resistance, light weight, and low maintenance versus MS alternatives. No BIS or IS standard specifically governs FRP security cabins as a product class; quality is determined by FRP panel thickness, MS frame gauge, and fitting quality. Buyers are primarily housing societies, construction contractors, industrial facilities, and security agencies; procurement is typically direct from manufacturer or through local dealers.
